source_diagnosis: The endpoint is an external-memory request-valid register, not the canonicalized static counter. Bank 140 content_en selects model_token_bank_out or lm_gemv_weight_bank_out according to the active read group; the external cell combines that enable with busy and duplicate-address suppression before setting request_queued. The exact mapped branch through that predicate is not yet isolated. Most reported delay is estimated interconnect.
decision: Do not add another RTL fix based only on placement. Obtain bounded production-tool routed timing for this candidate while its exact-image simulation finishes. Do not change PCIe, DDR3, clocks, constraints or seed. Do not convert/program on a timing failure or incomplete functional result.
